assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and the three key-area polygons are the repository's provisional rough polygons derived from the official announcement text and area values; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All areas, land-use partitions and phasing must be recalculated once official CAD/GIS boundary and key-area polygons are supplied; provisional geometry does not support official redline or precise-area claims.

assumptions.statement: Public facts cited from Haidian government, Beijing government, Beijing Daily/People's Daily, Beijing Science & Technology Commission and rail-line public notices were verified on 2026-08-08 via authoritative URLs; figures are point-in-time statistics.
assumptions.impact: Population, GDP, enterprise counts, park scale and rail-line facts are time-point statistics used for context; they should be re-verified against the latest official releases before statutory use.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints, road centerlines, green/public space polygons and phasing are schematic design communication layers generated by the AI agent; actual building scale, road alignments and facility standards await official conditions.
assumptions.impact: Design layers support conceptual review and visualization only; statutory engineering and regulatory conclusions are explicitly out of scope until official data and approval procedures are applied.
